about_the_game:
This DLC will only take effect when the base game is updated to version 1.0.0.0 or later!

If you are a big fan of game and want to support the game's development journey, this supporter pack will be your best choice!

Supporter package rewards

  • The experience-based cultivation manual  : After characters learn and cultivate this skill, they gain experience and attributes.

  • Level 7 treasure equipment "Lucky Coin" : +16% item drop chance, bonus treasure for early drops.

  • Protagonist Collector's Edition Phantom Type: One set for male and one for female.

  • Enable the "City Ground" function: Add 9 additional main plane city ground effects.

  • Collection method: Enter the main plane municipal center to collect the items!

This DLC is a supporter pack!

  • It is more suitable for helping new players speed up in the early stage of the game or for veteran players to collect

  • The value of the reward items and contents is relatively low. Whether purchased or not, it does not affect the normal game
